description: Where in Europe new grid connections for data centres are paused, rationed, conditional or congested, by country, with the measure's name, what it applies to and when it started. Without a country: the whole ranking. Use for questions like "where can I still connect a data centre to the grid in Europe", "is Ireland's grid moratorium still in force".

country.description: Optional European country, e.g. "Germany". Leave out for every country.

name: grid_connection_status
title: Grid connection status for data centres (Europe)
